title: VietIRREvidenceUnitRecord
description: Schema for a single evidence unit (text or table region) in the VietIRR-RAG dataset.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the parent document in the manifest.

evidence_id.description: Canonical unique ID of the evidence unit (e.g., REG_... or TAB_...).

page_id.description: Identifier of the page from which the unit originates.

index_text.description: Cleaned, search-indexed text representation of the unit.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the parent source document for provenance validation.
